title.narrative: MV: Digital Maldives for Adaptation, Decentralization and Diversification

description.narrative: The project development objective (PDO) is to enhance the competitiveness of the broadband market, to improve identification for in-person and online service delivery, and to leverage digital technologies, data, and analytics for climate resilience. The project is articulated around four components: (1) Enabling environment for improved digital connectivity and competitiveness; (2) Digital identification for improved online and in-person service delivery; (3) Digital technologies and data platform for climate resilience; and (4) Project management and implementation support. The project seeks to promote more affordable broadband-enabled services, put in place more secure, convenient, and privacy-conscious identification mechanisms for service delivery, and provide improved data and analytics for climate adaptation. This will improve people's, businesses, and government agencies access to broadband and to digital services and opportunities while also promoting data-driven climate policymaking and sustainable development across the public and private sectors.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2. Section I. A. (a). The Recipient shall establish, no later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, and thereaftermaintain, throughout the implementation of the Project, the Project Steering Committee (PSC), with membership, functions and termsof reference satisfactory to the Association, as set forth in the Project Operations Manual. Without limitation on the foregoing,the said committee shall be chaired by the Minister of Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology (MoECCT) or a seniorofficial designated by the Minister of MoECCT, and with representation from the Ministry of Finance (MoF), Ministry of NationalPlanning, Housing, and Infrastructure (MNPHI), President's Office, and such other stakeholders as shall be specified in the ProjectOperations Manual, and shall meet at least quarterly or subsequently as frequently as necessary to (i) support the Projectmanagement Unit (PMU) in providing strategic oversight and operational guidance for Project implementation and ensuresustainability of Project investments and interventions;(ii) facilitate inter-agency coordination to ensure adherence to theProject objectives; (iii) resolve any disputes or conflicts related to the Project; (iv) approve any policy, regulatory, andinstitutional recommendations; and (v) facilitate timely approvals for Project-related matters pertaining to the agencies includedin the PSC, where relevant.

Schedule 2. Section I. A. (b). The Recipient shall carry out the day-to-day management of the Project activities through the MoECCTand to this end, shall maintain at all times during the period of implementation of the Project, a PMU within MoECCT, withfunctions and resources satisfactory to the Association, and with competent staff in adequate numbers and with qualifications,experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association as further set forth in the Project Operations Manual. Withoutlimitation on the foregoing, the said PMU shall be headed by a Project Director and supported by a Project manager and shall beresponsible for, inter alia: (i) preparing the Annual Work Plans and Budgets for endorsement by the steering committee; (ii)carrying out the overall coordination and supervision of the execution of the Project including coordinating the implementation ofthe Project activities by each of the Implementing Agencies in accordance with their respective mandate; (iii) overseeing andguiding the administration of all coordination, management, procurement, financial management, and environmental and socialsafeguards management activities under the Project; (iv) carrying out the overall monitoring and evaluation of the Project; and (v)reporting to the said steering committee and liaising with the Association on any matters related to the progress of the Projectand the use of the proceeds of the Financing.

Schedule 2. Section I. A. (c). The Recipient shall ensure each of the Implementing Agencies designate, within one (1) month of theEffective Date, a focal point officer to facilitate the coordination of the Project activities implemented under its authority tobe maintained, through the period of implementation of the Project.

Schedule 2. Section I. B. The Recipient shall, (a) establish and implement the National Digital ID system and support themodernization of the foundational ID system in a manner which guarantees universal coverage and accessibility, and ensures that itsdesign is robust, secure, responsive and sustainable; and (b) ensure that the collection, processing and storage (includingtransfers to third parties) of Personal Data collected under the Project is done in accordance with the best internationalpractice, ensuring legitimate, appropriate, and proportionate treatment of such data; each, in accordance with the details setforth in the Project Operations Manual, and consistent with the Principles on Identification for Sustainable Development, untilsuch time as the Recipient has enacted and published in the official gazette, the relevant legislation and associated regulations,satisfactory to the Association, at which time implementation shall be done in accordance with such domestic legislation.

Schedule 2. Section I. E. During the implementation of the Project, the Recipient through the PMU shall prepare and furnish to theProject Steering Committee for approval and thereafter to the Association [no later than October 31](or such other date as theAssociation may agree) of each year for the Association's approval, an annual work plan and budget containing all eligible Projectactivities and expenditures proposed to be included in the Project for the Recipient's following fiscal year, together with aproposed budget and the environmental and social safeguard measures taken or planned to be taken in accordance with the provisionsof Section I.D of this Schedule.

Schedule 2. Section II. The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later than [one month] after the endof each [calendar semester], covering the [calendar semester]. Except as may otherwise be explicitly required or permitted underthis Agreement or as may be explicitly requested by the Association, in sharing any information, report or document related to theProject, the Recipient shall ensure that such information, report or document does not include Personal Data.
